conflicts_and_version_limits: Policy pages usually lack immutable revision dates. Retrieval date is recorded separately; index crawl dates and search crawl dates are not policy-effective dates.
Data Safety main collection guidance and later FAQ use inconsistent ephemeral-processing wording. Resolve exact behavior/form rather than invent a no-data exemption.
Exact English signing-help live retrieval failed; successful official locale/no-query retrieval and indexed evidence are distinctly labeled.
Signing help describes current Android 17/hybrid concepts; the Android Studio guide shows March 6, 2026 and earlier Android 13 rotation guidance. Do not infer this account’s enrollment.
DDA is effective September 15, 2025; signing terms August 1, 2021 supplement it. English and service-specific conflict provisions apply as stated; actual owner acceptance/addenda are unreviewed.

BIS overview descriptions are broader than current 15 CFR 742.15(b)(2) and 740.17(e)(3) scope. eCFR title current through October 14, 2026, title last amended September 24, 2026; these are not individual-clause amendment dates. No app classification is assigned.
The location guidance notes a change effective January 27, 2027. It is prospective and was not applied as an October 2026 violation.
